title: Record permutation decreasing-subsequence products
body:
## Summary
- For every pair of permutations of order at most 7, the longest decreasing subsequence of the composition is at most the product of the two lengths.
- There are 25,935,017 pairs. Equality holds for 44,061 of them.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
